chapter: Own groups, bebop and Savoy sessions
title: Don Byas sitting in on 52nd Street

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Oh, incredible. And you did quite a bit for Savoy with him.
Oh yeah. Did quite a few recordings with Don, with different groups. Maybe not with my own group, but I'd be on dates where he would be on.
Do you remember him sitting in a lot on 52nd Street?
You have that one picture hanging on the wall.

Oh yeah, him and Hawk and Monk. Oh sure. Just any time you catch him sitting in with anybody. You know, as you know 52nd Street was-a million places to play. Famous Door, Three Deuces and, the 18, Onyx Club, Caliani Club, Club 18, so just any time you're liable to stick your head in the door and see Don Byas up there playing with somebody, if he didn't have his own trio.
He had a reputation for being pretty aggressive.
Sitting in and burning a lot of guys off the stand.
